avoid_dishes.reason: Usually batter or flour coated (possibly beer batter), and the fryer is probably shared.

name: Señor Pico
questions: Are your taco tortillas 100% corn, and are they heated on the same plancha as flour tortillas?
Is the crispy fish battered with beer or wheat flour?

summary: Atly reviews, undated but on a currently listed venue, say GF items are labelled and that celiac diners ate safely.
